tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search the companies tracked by Venture Atlas by free text and/or industry. Matches company name, summary, product names, CEO, headquarters and industry names. Returns slim records with a trimmed brief; call get_company for the full profile. Omit `query` to list every company in an industry.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Full Venture Atlas profile for one company: summary, key metrics, forward-looking next steps with target dates, resolved milestone history with hit/slipped/missed outcomes, timeline, funding rounds and total, products, subsidiaries, and its news. Every field carries the source URL it came from.

tools.name: list_upcoming_milestones
tools.description: Announced, still-upcoming milestones with target dates across all tracked companies, soonest first. This is the forward-looking view: what each company has committed to next and by when, with the source for the commitment and that company's track record on past announcements. Filter by company or in

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: The Venture Atlas daily news digest, newest first. Each item is a sourced two-to-three-sentence summary of a material development (launch, funding round, regulatory milestone, contract, incident) with the companies it involves. Filter by company or by date.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company · Private data: search_companies, list_upcoming_milestones · Public sink: get_company, list_upcoming_milestones.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company · Private data: search_companies, list_upcoming_milestones · Public sink: get_company, list_upcoming_milestones

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
